name: feature.documents.nodes
description: Documents & Templates feature node pack — read + agentic-write nodes over the ctx.features.documents surface. list-documents reads an org's documents; assemble renders a template into an augmentedPrompt; generate-from-template assembles → ctx.callAI → creates a document + immutable version with a deterministic run/node-derived document id and idempotency key (a resume/crash-replay of the same run converges on the same rows; a :fork mints a fresh runId and deliberately creates its own document — the fork-backstop posture). Output is validated against the template-owned outputSchema; when the template binds a registered host artifact type, a typed artifact.created run event is emitted (RFC 0071 / ADR 0055). generate-from-template and render are role:side-effect durable writers.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Documents: List Documents
nodes.description: Lists an org's documents over ctx.features.documents. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Documents: List Templates
nodes.description: Lists an org's document templates over ctx.features.documents.listTemplates. Inputs: { orgId, kind? }. Output: { templates }. Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Documents: Get Template
nodes.description: Fetches one document template by id over ctx.features.documents.getTemplate. Inputs: { orgId, templateId }. Output: { template } (null when absent). Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Documents: Get Document
nodes.description: Fetches one document by id over ctx.features.documents.getDocument. Inputs: { orgId, documentId }. Output: { document } (null when absent). Tenant+org-guarded.

nodes.label: Documents: Assemble Template
nodes.description: Validates params against a template and renders its body into an augmentedPrompt + outputSchema. No LLM call.

nodes.label: Documents: Generate from Template
nodes.description: Assembles a template, calls ctx.callAI to draft the content, creates a document and an immutable version with a deterministic run/node-derived document id + idempotency key (a replay/fork converges on the same rows). Run-scoped generation; durable writer.

nodes.label: Documents: Render / Export
nodes.description: Renders a document's current version to one of seven formats (deterministic — no provider). Inputs: { orgId, documentId, format? } — format is one of: pdf (default), slides, sheet, docx, epub, odt, latex (ADR 0057 + ADR 0400). pdf/slides/sheet store durable Media library assets, idempotent per version+format — a re-render or replay converges on the SAME stored asset and token instead of minting duplicates or rewriting the immutable version's renderedMediaToken; docx/epub/odt/latex are REGENERABLE editable exports (latex = source-only .tex, no compile; math is faithful) stored as ~1-hour scratch Media (download-and-go — re-render to get a fresh link). Output: { versionId, format, renderedMediaToken, url, sizeBytes }. Fails typed: not_found (document), validation_error (unknown format, no content, >25 MiB export). Durable writer.
